lines.en: My wooden leg taps a dull rhythm.

lines.zh: 钩子挂在身侧，晃来晃去。
lines.en: The hook swings at my side.

lines.zh: 我走得歪歪斜斜，却很快。
lines.en: I walk crooked, but quickly.
A ragged curtain drags along the floor.

lines.zh: 脚步一深一浅，像在数拍。
lines.en: One step deep, one shallow, like a beat.
My rusted joints squeak.
I creep along the corridor.

lines.zh: 每走一步，布条就掉一缕。
lines.en: Each step sheds a thread of cloth.
I paused behind the door.

lines.zh: 灯泡忽明忽暗，我往前走。
lines.en: The bulb flickers and I move on.
My leather sole makes no sound.
I step around the broken glass.
My head tilts slightly as I walk.

lines.zh: 我拖着半截布袖走过去。
lines.en: I pass by, dragging a torn sleeve.

lines.zh: 皮套裂了，露出里面的杆。
lines.en: The suit is split, showing the rod inside.
One stride over the threshold.
I stand still and the bulb flickers.
Head tilted, perfectly still.
Half the paint's gone from my claws.
These rags are older than the suit.
My eye sockets are empty.
Is there still music from the stage?
I'm stuck in one pose.
The gear turned twice and stopped.
Light moves at the end of the hall.
I want to turn. The joint refuses.
What are you doing in this hall?

lines.zh: 我已经看过你很多次了。
lines.en: I've watched you many times.
Your flashlight doesn't reach me.

lines.zh: 我一尖叫，就不在原来的位置了。
lines.en: One scream and I am no longer where I was.
The door behind you is shut.
You're not afraid of me at all?

lines.zh: 我在这层走廊里看了你很久。
lines.en: I've been watching you down this corridor for a while.
Don't blink. I could vanish any moment.
My casing has cracked.
Wires are showing.
I step back and freeze a moment.
I shouldn't still feel pain.
Rags scatter on the floor.

lines.zh: 木腿裂了，我用钩子撑地。
lines.en: My wooden leg splits; I brace on my hook.

lines.zh: 钩子还挂在肩上，我站得住。
lines.en: My hook still hangs on my shoulder; I can stand.
Don't think that's the end.
I've been shut in here too long.
Keep that for yourself.
I can't smell anything.

lines.zh: 你举着它做什么，我只是一道残影。
lines.en: What are you raising at me? I am only a phantom.
A machine's body doesn't eat.
Is there something else in your hand?
I'm not hungry. I'm just hollow.
This body should have stopped long ago.
Eat. I'll wait.
You touched my hook.
Don't press up against me like this.
My shell is hard.

lines.zh: 你撞过来的时候在发抖。
lines.en: You were trembling when you hit me.
I'm heavier than I look.
Don't push. The joint will jam.
We shouldn't be touching.
You stepped on my rags.
I'm an animatronic.

lines.zh: 这具身体没有那种功能。
lines.en: This body has no such function.

lines.zh: 我被造出来时就没打算。
lines.en: I was never built for that.
What you say is strange.
I can't even repair myself.
There are no other animatronics here.
All I do is follow you.
Don't ask me about such things.
My stage has long been empty.
Be quiet. I'm listening.
I hook it up off the floor.

lines.zh: 这块铁锈可以派上用场。
lines.en: This rusted piece might be useful.
My hands aren't good at grabbing.
It fell by my foot.
This scrap of cloth is still good.

lines.zh: 我捡起来，只因为手会动。
lines.en: I pick it up because the hand moves.
A bit heavy — the hook slips.
I hang it up.
Take it away. Don't leave it here.
I heard that sound.

lines.zh: 木腿敲地三下，我数完了。
lines.en: Three knocks of my wooden leg — my count is done.
You looked this way.

lines.zh: 我的木腿在地上敲出闷响。
lines.en: My wooden leg knocks dully on the floor.
I've marked your position.
I should move faster.
Don't hide in that room.
Get near you, and you'll scream.

lines.zh: 我刚好在你必经的路上。
lines.en: I'm right on your path.
We're very close now.
My hook lines up with your collar.
You're behind the cabinet.
A moment more and I'm there.
The bulb just went out.
I'm coming along the wall.
You're at the last door.
The hook goes out first.
You don't dare move. Good.
I drag one foot.
This floor is unnaturally quiet.
Your light is pointing elsewhere.
The hook swings out.
A claw rakes at your shoulder.
The claw's already on you.
You're screaming. Good.

lines.zh: 这一下不算重，下一记会。
lines.en: That was light. The next won't be.
I shove you toward the wall.
The rags snagged your hand.
You dodged. I'm still here.
I open my mouth and nothing comes out.
This suit has worn through.

lines.zh: 我站在阴影和光的交界。
lines.en: I stand where shadow meets light.
Curtains hang off me.
I raise the hook and look at it.
I know this place well.
Head tilted, I slowly turn my face.
Someone called me back.

lines.zh: 地板上的灰被我踩出印。
lines.en: My footprints show in the dust.
I shouldn't still be standing.
Fire caught the cloth. I can't move.

lines.zh: 我从楼梯上滚下去，摔散了。
lines.en: I tumbled down the stairs and came apart.

lines.zh: 水进了电路，我抖个不停。
lines.en: Water in my circuits. I twitch.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的外壳撕开了。
lines.en: The blast tore my casing open.

lines.zh: 一根尖东西钉进我的壳。
lines.en: Something sharp stuck in my casing.

lines.zh: 那道光让我的齿轮倒转。
lines.en: That light turned my gears backward.

lines.zh: 雷击让我全身的灯都亮了。
lines.en: The strike lit every light in me.
I'm falling and my rags float upward.
